record.name: Volume
record.comment: Changes for correction #26 ('capitalization, PACS, other terms').
record.content: \emph{Volume} is a property associated with a finite region of space. The volume occupied by a given region of space $\Omega$ is typically denoted by the symbol $V$. It is always possible to subdivide a given region into smaller sub-regions. The symbol $dV$ is often used to denote the volume occupied by an arbitrarily small region of space. Thus the total volume occupied by $\Omega$ can be expressed as: $$ V = \int_{\Omega} dV $$
